request.style: English, lament, a women's choir in low close harmony and a solo alto, a single drone and a tolling bell, very slow, minor mode, grief without comfort, 50 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A voice is heard in Ramah
Lamentation and bitter weeping
Rachel is weeping for her children
She refuses to be comforted

[Chorus]
Because they are no more
Because they are no more

[Verse]
Herod was furious
He sent and killed all the boys in Bethlehem
And in all that region
Two years old and under

[Chorus]
Because they are no more
Because they are no more

[Outro]
Rachel weeping for her children
